title: Effect of Salmonella infection and IL12 on human Natural Killer cells
description: Human NK cells (2 donors, healthy)   Up: Unprimed IL12: Primed with IL12 Sal: Salmonella SL1344 (log) infected cells) VX: VX765, inflammatory caspase inhibitor

samples.title: Sample 1
samples.description: Protocols: Human NK cells was isolated by negative selection from healthy human blood. When indicated, cells were treated with IL12 overnight (100 ng/mL).  Sample were treated and collected after 5 hrs of infection with Salmonella (MOI 50).  When indicated, cells are treated with VX765 (25 micromolar) , 1 hr before infection, to imhibit inflammasome. 500k cells per condition were harvested by centrifugation and resuspended in Zymo buffer Zymo DNA/RNA Shield was used to resuspend the cell pellet. RNA was purified and processed by Plasmidsaurus Plasmidsaurus standard procedure, and were sequenced according to manufacturer procedures

runs.experiment_title: Illumina NovaSeq X sequencing: Effect of Salmonella infection and IL12 on human Natural Killer cells
